title: Finite affine refinement of a pro-etale cover
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and assume $S$ is quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. Let $\{W_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be a covering family of the small pro-étale site [sk-def-pe-site], and let $S=\bigcup_{\alpha=1}^t U_\alpha$ be a finite affine open cover [def-pc-scheme]. For each $\alpha$ there exist finitely many indices $i(\alpha,j)$ and affine opens $V_{\alpha j}\subset W_{i(\alpha,j)}\times_S U_\alpha$ whose images cover $U_\alpha$. The finite family $\{V_{\alpha j}\to S\}$ is itself a covering family of $S_{\mathrm{proét}}$: each map is weakly étale [sk-def-pe-morphisms], and the finite affine-refinement condition of [sk-def-pe-site] holds over every affine open of $S$.

source.place: (2) Local models, global bounds: finite affine refinement and verification that the finite family is a pro-etale cover

proof.text: For each $\alpha$, regard the affine open $U_\alpha\to S$ as an object of the small pro-étale site. Applying the covering clause of [sk-def-pe-site] to the given covering family $\{W_i\to S\}$ and the affine open $U_\alpha$ gives finitely many indices $i(\alpha,j)$ and affine opens $V_{\alpha j}\subset W_{i(\alpha,j)}\times_S U_\alpha$ whose images cover $U_\alpha$. This is exactly the asserted local finite refinement.

source.place: Step (2), Local models: finite affine refinement needed

proof.text: Each $W_i\to S$ is weakly étale by the object clause of [sk-def-pe-site]. Base change along $U_\alpha\to S$ preserves weak étaleness by [sk-lem-pe-weakly-etale-stability], so $W_i\times_S U_\alpha\to U_\alpha$ is weakly étale. Restricting its source to the affine open $V_{\alpha j}$ remains weakly étale by the locality-on-the-source clause of that node (apply it to the open cover $\{V_{\alpha j},W_i\times_SU_\alpha\}$). The open immersion $U_\alpha\to S$ is weakly étale by the same clause, as the restriction of $\mathrm{id}_S$ (flat with isomorphic diagonal, hence weakly étale by [sk-def-pe-morphisms]) to the open $U_\alpha$; so composing with $U_\alpha\to S$ is weakly étale by the composition clause. The fibre-product universal property [def-pc-fibre-product] identifies this composite with the displayed map $V_{\alpha j}\to S$.

source.place: Step (2), verification that the finite family is a pro-etale cover

proof.text: Let $W\subset S$ be any affine open. Since $S$ is quasi-separated, each intersection $W\cap U_\alpha$ is quasi-compact by [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-separated-affine-cover-criterion](1). The finite-affine-cover statement [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-finite-affine-open-cover] gives finitely many affine opens $A_{\alpha k}$ covering each $W\cap U_\alpha$. As the $U_\alpha$ cover $S$, the finitely many $A_{\alpha k}$ cover $W$.

source.place: Step (2), finite affine refinement over an arbitrary affine open of S

proof.text: For each $A_{\alpha k}$ and each selected $V_{\alpha j}$, form $V_{\alpha j}\times_{U_\alpha}A_{\alpha k}$. The fibre product of affine schemes over the affine scheme $U_\alpha$ is affine by [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra]. Since $A_{\alpha k}\subset W\cap U_\alpha$ and $U_\alpha\to S$ is an open immersion, the universal property [def-pc-fibre-product] identifies $V_{\alpha j}\times_{U_\alpha}A_{\alpha k}$ with $V_{\alpha j}\times_S A_{\alpha k}$, which is the open subscheme of $V_{\alpha j}\times_S W$ over the open $A_{\alpha k}\subset W$ (base change of the open immersion $A_{\alpha k}\to W$). Its image in $A_{\alpha k}$ is the intersection of the image of $V_{\alpha j}$ with $A_{\alpha k}$; hence, as $j$ varies, these finitely many affine opens have images covering $A_{\alpha k}$, because the images of the $V_{\alpha j}$ cover $U_\alpha\supset A_{\alpha k}$. Taking the finite union over $\alpha,k,j$ gives finitely many members $V_{\alpha j}$ of the new family and affine opens $V_{\alpha j}\times_SA_{\alpha k}\subset V_{\alpha j}\times_SW$ whose images cover $W$.

source.place: Step (2), finite affine refinement over every affine open of S

proof.text: The covering condition in [sk-def-pe-site], applied to the family $\{V_{\alpha j}\to S\}$ (so with the fibre products $V_{\alpha j}\times_SW$), is precisely the requirement verified in Step 4 for every affine open $W\subset S$, while Step 2 verifies weak étaleness of every member. Therefore the finite family $\{V_{\alpha j}\to S\}$ is a covering family in the small pro-étale site. Its index set is finite because both the affine cover and each local refinement are finite.

source.place: Step (2), verification that the finite family is a pro-etale cover

split_report.summary: Split the finite affine refinement argument into five steps. The given pro-etale covering condition supplies finite affine refinements over each affine U_alpha; weak etale stability gives the maps to S; quasi-separated affine intersections and finite affine covers reduce an arbitrary affine W to finitely many affine pieces; affine fibre products then provide the required finite refinement over W. No new nodes were needed: all non-elementary inputs are existing DAG leaves or the existing weak-etale stability statement.
split_report.blueprint: All five steps realize Step (2) of det-prop-scalar-six-ctf.proof.md: the local finite refinement paragraph and the subsequent verification that the finite family is a pro-etale cover.
